```text
# Authors

## Primary Author

**Alex Polo** - WAU Technologies  
- Production implementation (WAU Technologies customer project)
- Initial skill design and documentation
- Real-world validation (2.5M records, 3-day migration)

## Acknowledgments

This skill was extracted from a production implementation for a WAU Technologies customer. The patterns were developed to solve a real-world post-migration synchronization challenge involving 2.5 million records across 10 tables.

Special thanks to:
- WAU Technologies development team for architecture review
- Customer IT team for production validation and feedback

## Contributing

Contributions are welcome! See `CONTRIBUTING.md` for guidelines on:
- Adding new patterns
- Improving examples
- Reporting issues
- Suggesting enhancements

To contribute:
1. Fork the AL Copilot Skills Collection repository
2. Create a feature branch
3. Make your changes
4. Submit a pull request

All contributors will be listed here with their contributions.

## License

This skill is part of the AL Copilot Skills Collection and is licensed under the MIT License.
```
